build_esm2_model: build an ESM2 protein language model with configurable layers, embed_dim, and attention heads
run_esm2_forward: run the ESM2 forward pass on tokenized protein sequences to get logits and hidden representations
run_esm2_contacts: run the ESM2 model to predict protein contact maps from attention head weights
review_esm2_init_submodules: review the ESM2 _init_submodules method that creates TransformerLayer stack, contact head, and LM head
summarize_esm2_token_dropout: summarize the ESM2 token dropout mechanism that masks and rescales embeddings during training
